note: 制空权分析 SQL 模板。当前面向演示库 mock_situation（mock_aircraft + mock_aircraft_type），按阵营(faction)聚合；该演示库没有区域维度，{region} 仅作为结果标签随行返回，不参与过滤。

groups.description: 双方在某区域的空中占位能力对比

queries.label: 红蓝双方占位能力对比
queries.sql: SELECT '{region}' AS region, faction AS side, COUNT(*) AS aircraft_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '在役' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '战损' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lost_count FROM mock_aircraft GROUP BY faction ORDER BY aircraft_count DESC

groups.description: 双方在某区域的空中打击能力对比

queries.label: 红蓝双方打击能力对比
queries.sql: SELECT '{region}' AS region, a.faction AS side, ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(t.strike_radius_km, 0)), 1) AS avg_strike_radius_km, MAX(t.strike_radius_km) AS max_strike_radius_km, SUM(t.combat_load_kg) AS total_combat_load_kg FROM mock_aircraft a JOIN mock_aircraft_type t ON a.type_id = t.type_id GROUP BY a.faction

groups.description: 双方在某区域的空中侦察能力对比

queries.label: 红蓝双方侦察能力对比
queries.sql: SELECT '{region}' AS region, a.faction AS side, ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(t.recon_radius_km, 0)), 1) AS avg_recon_radius_km, MAX(t.max_altitude_m) AS max_altitude_m, ROUND(AVG(t.cruise_speed_kmh), 0) AS avg_cruise_speed_kmh FROM mock_aircraft a JOIN mock_aircraft_type t ON a.type_id = t.type_id GROUP BY a.faction

groups.description: 双方在某区域的总体制空能力综合对比

queries.label: 红蓝双方总体制空能力对比
queries.sql: SELECT '{region}' AS region, a.faction AS side, COUNT(*) AS aircraft_count, ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(t.recon_radius_km, 0)), 1) AS avg_recon_radius_km, ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(t.strike_radius_km, 0)), 1) AS avg_strike_radius_km, SUM(t.combat_load_kg) AS total_combat_load_kg, ROUND(AVG(t.max_speed_kmh), 0) AS avg_max_speed_kmh FROM mock_aircraft a JOIN mock_aircraft_type t ON a.type_id = t.type_id GROUP BY a.faction
